title: DateUtilTests can fail based on timezone
body:
I'm in Pacific Daylight Time ("America/Los_Angeles") so my default timezone gives me a different day of month than, say, UTC. This causes several failures in [`DateUtilTest`](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/dev/core/main/src/test/java/info/nightscout/core/utils/DateUtilTest.kt):

- `dateAndTimeRangeStringTest`
- `dateStringTest`
- `dateAndTimeStringTest`

`TimeZone.setDefault` can fix this in a `@BeforeAll` test set up.
